spec.reasoning: At $250 every date on this tour is already in reach — the highest floor price in the snapshot is Nashville at $118 — so a price filter would remove nothing and just imply a constraint she does not have. That changes the question from 'what can I afford' to 'which night is worth it', so I dropped the filter, kept chronological order, and highlighted best value rather than cheapest. Standard rather than hero prominence because with no price pressure the list is a browse, not an answer.
